rows.text: Once again, you bump into Oswaldo Schneider's disciple at the bazaar. He looks like he has aged a lot. The economy on Varunix is in recession, and the bazaar is quiet and deserted.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: "Ah... You're right. There was no prize in the random pool of the previous Super Goodies game." He concedes guiltily.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: "But I promise I'll give it to you, as you trust me and are my regular customer. Next, I'll teach you the last rule of business: Never lie to your customers." He grins.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe
